service.description: A proposed revision of a purchase order: the lines' and the part's new values.

parameter.name: orderRevision
parameter.description: The revision the change was reviewed at; the current one when empty.

parameter.name: itemChanges
parameter.description: Each changed line: orderItemSeqId with its new quantity, unitAmount, requiredByDate, itemDescription or productId (a substitute, under the buying policy's substitution rule).

parameter.name: partChanges
parameter.description: The part's new vendorPartyId, currencyUomId, facilityId, postalContactMechId, estimatedDeliveryDate, settlementTermId or tradeTermEnumId.

service.description: Start changing a placed, approved or sent purchase order (design OrderChanges, D7): a Change hold (hold#Order, OhtChange) with the reason, its source the revision it starts from; a sent order un-sends to Approved first. Receiving goes on (a receipt posted while a change is reviewed fails its apply, RECEIPT_IN_PROGRESS). An open change is answered (alreadyStarted). Refuses a draft or a closed order (ORDER_NOT_REVISABLE), a revision that is not the current one (STALE_REVISION) and no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

Let a started change go before anything is applied: its Change hold is released and the order returns to its status before. Refuses an order with no open change (REVISION_NOT_STARTED) and one whose new revision was applied and waits for its approval (REVISION_APPLIED).

The effects of a proposed revision, nothing written (design ProposedChange and RevisionEffects): the change rows with old and new values and each one's refusal by name (QUANTITY_BELOW_RECEIVED, _BILLED, _RETURNED, _ACCEPTED; SUPPLIER_CHANGE_PROGRESSED and CURRENCY_CHANGE_PROGRESSED on a part that was received or billed; SUBSTITUTION_NOT_ALLOWED, SUBSTITUTE_PROGRESSED, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE; FACILITY_ON_RECEIPT), each line's ordered, received, billed, returned, accepted and expected quantities, the amount of each changed line before and after, and the basis key apply#PurchaseRevision checks. Needs PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or PURCHASE_APPROVE.

parameter.name: revisionState
parameter.description: none, started (the hold, nothing applied) or applied (waiting for the approval of the new revision).

parameter.name: partValues
parameter.description: The part's current supplier, currency, facility, ship-to address, delivery date, payment term and incoterm; partTexts the same as text.

parameter.name: changeRows
parameter.description: entity, orderItemSeqId, field, whatText, oldValue, newValue, fromText, toText, refusalCode, refusalText.

service.description: Apply a reviewed revision of a started change in one transaction (design ApplyRevision, Lock and apply): the order's open receipts and the order locked (receipt first, as the receive guard), the changes written to the audit-logged fields with the reason (and an internal note), the revision counted once (increment#OrderRevision, which supersedes the earlier revision's decisions), each open receipt set to its line's new remainder (mantle.shipment.WarehouseTaskServices.adjust#ExpectedReceipt), the budget a lowered line no longer needs released (mantle.other.BudgetServices.lower#SourceCommitments; a raised line is reserved by the approval), each changed line's matched bills queued for re-evaluation (mantle.account.InvoiceMatchServices queue#MatchReevaluation), and the new revision sent to its approvers. The order stays held until the approval of the new revision (decide#PurchaseApproval) releases the Change hold. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Refuses an order with no change started (REVISION_NOT_STARTED), a revision that is not the current one (STALE_REVISION), a receipt or bill posted since the preview's basis (RECEIPT_IN_PROGRESS, nothing changes), a refused change row (its code), no change (NO_CHANGE) and no reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: basisKey
parameter.description: The preview's basis key: a receipt or bill posted since fails the apply.

service.description: Record the supplier's acknowledgement of a purchase order's current revision on its behalf (design RecordAcknowledgement): its reference and date, the outcome (accepted, accepted with changes or rejected) with the supplier's note, each line's promised date and quantity, all audit-logged; the requested date and the ordered quantity stay (a changed promise goes to the buyer, and a quantity changes only through a revision). The evidence (a file, or how it came: a phone call, an email) is the order's content in the supplier's role. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Refuses an order not sent (ORDER_NOT_SENT), an older revision (SUPERSEDED_REVISION, naming the current one), an unknown outcome (OUTCOME_INVALID), a changed or rejected one without the supplier's reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and a line not on the order (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: lineAcknowledgements
parameter.description: Each line's orderItemSeqId, promisedDate and promisedQuantity.

service.description: Remind suppliers to acknowledge their purchase orders' current revisions (design SendReminder): per order, in its own transaction, the supplier's order addresses (else its primary ones; toAddresses for one order) each get the reminder through send#EmailTemplate (MANTLE_PURCHASE_REMINDER by default), recorded as an OrderEmailMessage with the revision and occurrence; a recipient already reminded of the revision, template and occurrence (by default today) is skipped. A result per order (SENT, PARTLY_SENT, SKIPPED, FAILED or the refusal: ORDER_NOT_SENT, ALREADY_ACKNOWLEDGED, RECIPIENT_REQUIRED) and per recipient (sent, queued, skipped or failed with RECIPIENT_INVALID or DELIVERY_FAILED); one order's failure does not stop the others.

parameter.name: occurrence
parameter.description: The reminder's occurrence, by default today's date: a recipient is reminded once per revision, template and occurrence.

parameter.name: single
parameter.description: Internal: one order, run per order in its own transaction.

parameter.name: results
parameter.description: Each order's orderId, orderRevision, resultCode, message and recipientResults (recipient, status, reasonCode, emailMessageId).
